name: Pamplin's Inspiring Possibilities (PIP) Academy
org: Virginia Tech Pamplin College of Business
what_you_do: Spend ten days on campus. Learn about business majors like money, sales, hotels and real estate. Work on a team project. Meet teachers, graduates and company partners.
who_can_apply: High school students who start their senior year in 2026-27. You need a GPA of 3.5 out of 4.0 or the same in another scale. You need to have done or be doing pre-calculus. You also write a short note about why you are interested.
pay_detail: Free. The page says cost of attendance is covered except travel to and from Blacksburg. No pay.
duration: 10 days, residential (page dates: Thursday July 9 to Saturday July 18)
deadline_text: Application deadline not shown on the page. The page shows the 2026 session; the next one for seniors in 2027-28 is not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the PIP page and submit a statement of interest. Questions: PCOBrecruiting@vt.edu.
notes: Only for rising seniors, so a teen has one chance to apply. Travel to Blacksburg is on the family.
